
### Types

```text
interface CheckOptions
  blocks?: XLEBlock[]
  form?: 'auto' | 'compact' | 'outline'
  loose?: boolean
interface CheckResult
  compact?: string
  errors: XLEIssue[]
  form?: 'compact' | 'outline'
  ok: boolean
  outline?: string
  parseError?: {message: string; line?: number; col?: number}
  valid?: boolean
  warnings: string[]
interface ExpandOptions extends CheckOptions
  blocks?: XLEBlock[]
  form?: 'auto' | 'compact' | 'outline'
  loose?: boolean
  name?: string
type ExpandResult = | {ok: false; errors: XLEIssue[]} | { ok: true; form: 'compact' | 'outline'; code: string; componentsUsed: string[]; states: number; todos: string[]; warnings: string[] }
interface SerializedRegistry
  aliases: Array<[string, string]>
  componentNames: string[]
  components: Array<{ name: string; exportName: string; dirName: string; importPath: string; undocumented?: boolean; props: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }>
interface XLEBlock
  category?: string
  description?: string
  dirName: string
interface XLEIssue
  col?: number
  formatted: string
  kind?: string
  line?: number
  message: string
  suggestions?: string[]
```
